name: standing-cable-hamstring-curl.html
instructions:
1. Set up for the standing cable hamstring curl by attaching an ankle strap to the low pulley of a cable machine and setting the weight on the stack.
2. Position a block or a step in front of the machine to stand on for a better range of motion.
3. Attach the strap to your left ankle and stand on the block with your right foot, allowing your left foot to hang off to the side.
4. Stand with a slight bend in your knee and grab onto the machine with both hands for stability. This is the starting position.
5. Bending at the knee, slowly lift your left ankle up behind you toward your buttocks.
6. Raise your foot as high as comfortably possible and pause for a moment squeezing your hamstrings.
7. Slowly lower the weight to the starting position and repeat for desired reps.
8. Repeat using your right leg
